item.tib: sa srid pa'i rgyal pos zhus pa'i klu gnyan sa bdag gi pang kong
sa srid pa'i rgyal mo'i zhus pa'i klu gnyan sa bdag gi pang kong
item.coloph: klu gnyan sa bdag gi spang skong las / byin brlabs phan yon bstan pa'i le'u ste brgyad pa'o // klu gnyan sa bdag gi spang skong rdzogs so // bkra shis par shog
item.note: the eight chapter titles listed here correspond very closely to the eight chapter titles of the text listed in ytkc, pp. 194-195, with the title sa bdag gi spa bkong, a gter ma of the two a-tsa-ra at bsam-yas dkor-khong [~dkor-khang?]. however, the following passage from brgyud rim, says that it was found at bsam-yas skor-khang by the three a-tsa-ra.

item.tib: sa srid pa'i rgyal mos zhus pa'i klu gnyan sa bdag gi pang kong
